ruling: - **R27. The feedback log tends itself.** Owner 10:16 CST Nov 11: "this should've been a trigger for something that should've been mechanizable remember, we can't have sesisons fualting themselves for something that could bve cvorrected?" and "it seems like basically this was a good idea but it's execution was a little half baked in that it's never cleaned up after or tended to?". Case: the Stop check asked this session to keep 17 settled items in its handoff. Its remedy named only "put them in the handoff", never "mark [closed]". So the session copied ids to pass the check. Measured 10:17 CST in this session's log: 126 items, 57 rulings and 9 standing items still open, none closed by a tool. 1. A ruling or task item closes itself when its home holds it on main. The Stop check already proves the home; it marks the line [closed] in the same rewrite that marks repeats. 2. Each refusal of the check names [closed] as a way out, beside the handoff (R24). 3. The compaction reminder lists only items that still need work. 4. Owner words that reach a session by the question box or by relay are saved like a typed message. Home: decision owner-feedback-inbox. Runs with R16, which files a told mistake as a missing guard.
